panels.description: The Air Quality Index (AQI) is a standardized tool used by government agencies to communicate daily air pollution levels and their corresponding public health risks

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  CASE
    WHEN pm25 <= 30 THEN (50.0 / 30.0) * pm25
    WHEN pm25 <= 60 THEN 50 + ((100.0 - 50.0) / 30.0) * (pm25 - 30)
    WHEN pm25 <= 90 THEN 100 + ((200.0 - 100.0) / 30.0) * (pm25 - 60)
    WHEN pm25 <= 120 THEN 200 + ((300.0 - 200.0) / 30.0) * (pm25 - 90)
    WHEN pm25 <= 250 THEN 300 + ((400.0 - 300.0) / 130.0) * (pm25 - 120)
    ELSE 500
  END AS aqi
FROM pollution
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: AQI

panels.description: PM2.5 refers to fine atmospheric particulate matter (air pollution) with a diameter of 2.5 micrometers or less, making it roughly 30 times smaller than the width of a human hair.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  pm25 AS "PM 2.5"
FROM pollution
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Active Hotspots"
FROM (
  SELECT
    sensor_id,
    MAX(time) AS latest_time
  FROM pollution
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY sensor_id
) latest
JOIN pollution p
  ON p.sensor_id = latest.sensor_id
  AND p.time = latest.latest_time
WHERE p.pm25 > 90

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    sensor_id,
    MAX(time) AS latest_time
  FROM pollution
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY sensor_id
)
SELECT
  p.sensor_id AS "Sensor",
  p.lat AS "Latitude",
  p.lon AS "Longitude",
  p.pm25 AS "PM2.5",
  p.pm10 AS "PM10",
  p.no2 AS "NOâ",
  p.o3 AS "Oâ",
  CASE
    WHEN p.pm25 <= 30 THEN 'Good'
    WHEN p.pm25 <= 60 THEN 'Satisfactory'
    WHEN p.pm25 <= 90 THEN 'Moderately Polluted'
    WHEN p.pm25 <= 120 THEN 'Poor'
    WHEN p.pm25 <= 250 THEN 'Very Poor'
    ELSE 'Severe'
  END AS "Severity"
FROM pollution p
JOIN latest l
  ON p.sensor_id = l.sensor_id
  AND p.time = l.latest_time
ORDER BY p.pm25 DESC
